task_text: Wash the dirty dishes and utensils, make the bed

central_instructions.R1: Use your gripper to pass the dirty dishes and utensils to R2 for washing.
central_instructions.R2: Receive the dirty dishes and utensils from R1 and wash them in the kitchen.
central_instructions.R3: Move to the kitchen to assist R2 if needed, then return to the bedroom to help R4 make the bed.
central_instructions.R4: Work with R3 to make the bed in the bedroom.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the mug to R2 for washing. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Take the mug from R1. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the fork from the sink basin. (r1_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the fork to R2 for washing. (r1_s4)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Take the fork from R1. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the spoon from the sink basin. (r1_s5)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the spoon to R2 for washing. (r1_s6)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Take the spoon from R1. (r2_s3)

(Note: Making the bed is not possible for R1 as it cannot move to another room.)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [PASS] Hand dirty dishes and utensils to R2 (r1_s1)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive dirty dishes and utensils from R1 (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Wash the dirty dishes and utensils using the dish sponge in the sink basin (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the clean dishes and utensils on the drying rack (r2_s3)

(Note: Making the bed is not possible for R2 due to capability limitations.)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the kitchen to assist R2 (r3_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Begin washing dirty dishes and utensils (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Continue washing dirty dishes and utensils (r2_s2)
- R3 [HELP] Assist R2 with washing dishes by handing over light objects (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Finish washing dirty dishes and utensils (r2_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Return to the bedroom (r3_s3)

[15-20 min]
- R3 [HELP] Assist R4 in making the bed by arranging pillows (r3_s4)
- R4 [LOCAL] Start making the bed (r4_s1)

[20-25 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Finish making the bed (r4_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the bed is neatly made (r3_s5)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [ASK_HELP] Request R3 to assist in making the bed. (r4_s1)
- R3 [HELP] Agree to help R4 with making the bed. (r3_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Begin straightening the bed sheets. (r4_s2)
- R3 [HELP] Assist R4 by tucking in the corners of the bed sheets. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Adjust the pillows and arrange them neatly on the bed. (r4_s3)
- R3 [HELP] Smooth out any wrinkles on the bedspread. (r3_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Confirm the bed is made and thank R3 for the assistance. (r4_s4)
- R3 [LOCAL] Acknowledge the completion of the task and return to its previous activity. (r3_s4)
